origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi analyse 警 comme 言, la parole, et 敬, le respect, qui donne aussi le son. 敬 se lit jìng, la même syllabe que 警, jǐng. Des mots qui mettent en garde : alerter, et la police, 警察.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi analyses 警 as 言, speech, and 敬, respect, which also gives the sound. 敬 is read jìng, the same syllable as 警, jǐng. Words that put you on guard: to warn, and the police, 警察.
